body.p: Body weight at which the exchange flows of the tissue distribution (ftissue_<sid>) are given; they scale with the body weight as the volumes, the blood flows and the renal clearance do.

body.p: Assumed FQgu is the sum of FQgu + FQsp + FQpa for correct portal blood flow. with FQgu=0.146, FQsp=0.017, FQpa=0.017

rest of body fractional tissue blood flow
fraction of portal venous blood shunted by the liver
fraction of lost parenchymal liver volume

body.p: GFR per renal blood flow (94.5 ml/l). Calibrated so that the healthy GFR is 101 ml/min at the renal blood flow of 1.06875 l/min of 75 kg, the normal GFR of the classes of renal impairment (pkpdsim.impairment).
The GFR of healthy kidneys, which scales with the renal blood flow and so with the body weight; the GFR is KI__f_renal_function times this rate.
Exchange flow at the reference body weight BW_ref.
The value of Kp_pra is the result of the fit PK_20261019_164944__7b050, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Ratio of the deep to the free concentration of the rest tissue in the equilibrium of the slow distribution: with Kp it sets the volume of distribution of the terminal phase.

parameter.name: rate of the deep distribution pra

body.p: Rate of the slow exchange between the rest tissue and its deep compartment: the concentrations fall fast in the first 2 hr after a dose (distribution and elimination) and slower after it (terminal half-life 0.8 hr after an intravenous dose, 1.5-2 hr after an oral dose).

parameter.name: Cumulative dose due to infusion pra

body.p: log(2) ~ 0.693 used for conversion of half-life injection time to injection rate.
